rows: Section 1. AMENDMENT OF SECTION 2.103 OF THE TOWN CHARTER.
Section 2.103 of the Town Charter (Ga.L. 1994, p. 4782) is hereby amended, by striking
Section 2.103 Compensation and Expenses. The Mayor shall receive compensation of
Thomas L. Fitzgerald Jessica M. Mallanda
R. David Syfan Jason E. Voyles
Filing Notice Of Proposed Ordinance For Salary Increase
Attorney For Town Of Clermont, Georgia
To Provide A Salary For Each Councilmember Of $120.00
Per Month; To Provide That The Mayor And Council Are
Also Entitled To Reimbursement For Expenses Actually
And Necessarily Incurred By Them In Carrying Out
Their Official Duties; To Repeal Conflicting Provisions
Of The Charter And For Other Purposes,
